countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Countries to read, by name or slug: united-states, united-kingdom, japan, worldwide... Use all for every one of the 62 locations. Common short forms work (us, uk, uae).

hoursAgo.title: Hours ago
hoursAgo.description: Which hourly snapshots to read: 0 is now, 1 to 23 are that many hours ago. E.g. 0, 6, 12, 18 for four snapshots across the day.

maxTrendsPerList.title: Max trends per list
maxTrendsPerList.description: Top N trends kept from each list, 1 to 50.

includeTopLists.title: Add most-tweeted and longest-trending lists
includeTopLists.description: Also read, per country, the trends with the highest tweet score and those that trended the most hours over the chosen period.

topListPeriod.title: Top lists period
topListPeriod.description: Time window for the most-tweeted and longest-trending lists.
